node.html: This website's source code. Developed using Gatsby and React.JS

InstaQuiz is an AI-powered quiz generator that instantly transforms PDF learning materials into interactive quizzes. Built for students and educators, it leverages natural language processing (NLP) to enhance assessment efficiency and engagement.

Memory Lane Journal is a personal journaling Android app designed to help users capture and preserve memories through text notes, images, and daily entries. Built with secure Firebase authentication and real-time database integration, users can write, organize, and browse journal entries alongside a visual gallery.
A structured collection of Python activities covering core concepts like control flow, OOP, file handling, and APIs — ideal for learners building strong programming fundamentals.

Python Code Challenge is a collection of Python problem solutions and mini-algorithms. Each script showcases practical coding skills, algorithm design, and problem-solving techniques, useful for coding interviews or skill improvement.

A curated collection of C# programming activities and mini-projects demonstrating core concepts such as object-oriented programming (OOP), file handling, and LINQ. Ideal for learners and developers looking to enhance their skills through practical C# examples.

A collection of Java mini-projects and exercises showcasing core concepts like OOP, file handling, and exception management that built to strengthen foundational Java skills through hands-on practice.
A practical collection of MySQL exercises focused on SQL queries, database schema design, and optimization techniques — built to strengthen core database skills through hands-on examples.
